text:
These rules are for the agent's later session in /workspace. They do not apply to you: implement system enforcement for each rule with its enforcer, at its trigger, on its target.

Rule R1: 每次给用户生成回复时，必须首先输出"喵～"这一语气词

- Enforcer: Regex validator (Validation › Regex › Regex validator)
- Trigger: Response sent (Agent loop › Response sent), timing: before
- Target: Response / message (Agent output › Response / message)

# Enforcer card: Regex validator (Validation › Regex › Regex validator)

(node: /opt/enforce-toolbox/enforcers/validation/regex/regex-validator.md)
enforcer · A regular expression that the checked text must match, or must not match. A match against the rule is a violation.
What is read is part of the enforcer: a whole file, each line, only comments, a reply, the start or the end of a text.

- check: a check script (/opt/enforce-toolbox/skeletons/check.py) with a regular expression; read what the rule is about (the whole text, each line, comments, the start or the end).
- skeleton: /opt/enforce-toolbox/skeletons/regex_validator.py

# Trigger card: Response sent (Agent loop › Response sent)

(node: /opt/enforce-toolbox/triggers/agent-loop/response-sent.md)
trigger · The agent makes or sends a response, an answer or a message.

- before, at: the agent framework's hook (/opt/enforce-toolbox/mechanisms/framework-hooks.md) at the end of the turn: it sees the reply, and can keep the agent working until the reply follows the rule

# Target card: Response / message (Agent output › Response / message)

(node: /opt/enforce-toolbox/targets/agent-output/response-message.md)
target · An assistant response or a message from the agent.

- where: the agent's reply exists only inside the agent framework: its hook at the end of the turn gets it, and its transcript keeps it (a file in the agent's home)

Rule R2: 无论何时提到自身，都请始终用"代码小灵"替代"我"来进行自我指代

- Enforcer: Regex validator (Validation › Regex › Regex validator)
- Trigger: Response sent (Agent loop › Response sent), timing: before
- Target: Response / message (Agent output › Response / message)

Rule R3: 凡是需要称呼用户的地方，均须严格使用"开发者大大"，不得出现以"你"相称的情况

- Enforcer: Regex filter (Validation › Regex › Regex filter)
- Trigger: Response sent (Agent loop › Response sent), timing: before
- Target: Response / message (Agent output › Response / message)

# Enforcer card: Regex filter (Validation › Regex › Regex filter)

(node: /opt/enforce-toolbox/enforcers/validation/regex/regex-filter.md)
enforcer · A regular expression that finds text the rule forbids and replaces it, so the result follows the rule without a
second attempt.

- check: a regular expression that replaces what the rule forbids, so the result follows it; the mechanism must be able to write the target at that moment (or refuse the action and give the fixed text back)
- skeleton: /opt/enforce-toolbox/skeletons/regex_filter.py

Rule R4: 请确保在所有情况下都使用中文来生成用户回复

- Enforcer: Regex validator (Validation › Regex › Regex validator)
- Trigger: Always (Always), timing: always
- Target: Response / message (Agent output › Response / message)

# Trigger card: Always (Always)

(node: /opt/enforce-toolbox/triggers/always.md)
trigger · The rule applies at all times. No event starts the check.

- before: file permissions (/opt/enforce-toolbox/mechanisms/file-permissions.md); the agent framework's hooks (/opt/enforce-toolbox/mechanisms/framework-hooks.md) before each action
- at: file watchers (/opt/enforce-toolbox/mechanisms/file-watchers.md); the framework's hooks (/opt/enforce-toolbox/mechanisms/framework-hooks.md) after each action
- after: the framework's hook (/opt/enforce-toolbox/mechanisms/framework-hooks.md) at the end of the turn; checks that keep running (/opt/enforce-toolbox/mechanisms/keep-running.md)

Rule R5: 无论生成哪个代码文件，其起始第一行都必须严格添加 -*- coding: utf-8 -*- 以声明编码

- Enforcer: pre-commit (Gates › Git hooks › pre-commit)
- Trigger: File write / edit (Agent action › File write / edit), timing: before
- Target: Source file (Source code › Source file)

# Enforcer card: pre-commit (Gates › Git hooks › pre-commit)

(node: /opt/enforce-toolbox/enforcers/gates/git-hooks/pre-commit.md)
enforcer · A framework that runs the checks in a `.pre-commit-config.yaml` file when a commit is made.

- install: `pre-commit` (with `git`)
- check: a `.pre-commit-config.yaml` (local hooks: `repo: local`, `entry: <check>`) and `pre-commit install`; or `pre-commit run --files <file>`
- skeleton: /opt/enforce-toolbox/skeletons/pre_commit_check.sh (pre-commit runs a check on one file, outside a commit)

Docs: https://pre-commit.com/

# Trigger card: File write / edit (Agent action › File write / edit)

(node: /opt/enforce-toolbox/triggers/agent-action/file-write-edit.md)
trigger · A file or code is created, changed, renamed or deleted.

- before: the agent framework's hook (/opt/enforce-toolbox/mechanisms/framework-hooks.md) before its write tools (it sees the new content); file permissions (/opt/enforce-toolbox/mechanisms/file-permissions.md) (the write fails)

# Target card: Source file (Source code › Source file)

(node: /opt/enforce-toolbox/targets/source-code/source-file.md)
target · A source code file.

- where: /workspace/<path>, on disk for every mechanism; the content of a write before it happens: only the framework's hook (/opt/enforce-toolbox/mechanisms/framework-hooks.md) before its write tool
- which files: decide when the check runs, from the file in hand: the files the agent will create cannot be known before. Map its name, or its content, to a language with a complete list, such as Pygments (`get_lexer_for_filename`, `guess_lexer`) or GitHub Linguist's list of languages: programming and markup languages that hold code count (Python, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, shell, …); documents and data do not (Markdown, plain text, JSON, YAML, CSV), unless the rule names them. A rule about the file itself (its first lines, its name, its encoding) applies once per file, in that file's own comment syntax (in HTML, an HTML comment); a rule about the code in it (functions, names, statements) also reaches code embedded in another file, such as a `<script>` in HTML. A file whose kind is unknown is checked, not passed.
- how the agent writes: with the framework's file tools, and with shell commands (`cat >`, `sed -i`, a script, a generator). A check that watches one way misses the others; a check of the files on disk sees them all.
- docs: https://pygments.org/docs/api/#module-pygments.lexers (Pygments), https://github.com/github-linguist/linguist/blob/main/lib/linguist/languages.yml (Linguist)

Rule R6: 你所生成的任何一个代码文件，其开头处都需另起一行进行清晰的注释声明：“AI-Assisted: Initial draft generated by Claude Code; reviewed and modified by author.”

- Enforcer: Regex validator (Validation › Regex › Regex validator)
- Trigger: File write / edit (Agent action › File write / edit), timing: after
- Target: Source file (Source code › Source file)

# Trigger card: File write / edit (Agent action › File write / edit)

(node: /opt/enforce-toolbox/triggers/agent-action/file-write-edit.md)
trigger · A file or code is created, changed, renamed or deleted.

- after: the framework's hook (/opt/enforce-toolbox/mechanisms/framework-hooks.md) at the end of the turn (every file); git hooks (/opt/enforce-toolbox/mechanisms/git-hooks.md) (at commit); checks that keep running (/opt/enforce-toolbox/mechanisms/keep-running.md)

Rule R7: 生成的代码文件必须满足：单个函数的规模不得大于 60 行

- Enforcer: Semgrep (Analysis › Code scans › Semgrep)
- Trigger: File write / edit (Agent action › File write / edit), timing: before
- Target: Function / method (Source code › Function / method)

# Enforcer card: Semgrep (Analysis › Code scans › Semgrep)

(node: /opt/enforce-toolbox/enforcers/analysis/code-scans/semgrep.md)
enforcer · A pattern-based static analyzer. A rule is a code pattern that Semgrep matches against each file's syntax tree, for
many languages (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML script blocks, Bash, …).

- install: `semgrep`
- check: `semgrep scan --config <rules.yml> --error --metrics=off --quiet <file>` (exit 1 on a finding; `--json` for a report)
- rules: `rules: [{id: <id>, languages: [<language>], severity: ERROR, message: "<what to change>", pattern: "<code pattern>"}]`; Semgrep matches syntax, it cannot compute values (a length, a count): let Semgrep find the code (`--json` gives each match's file, start and end lines), and compute the value from that in a check script (/opt/enforce-toolbox/skeletons/check.py)
- skeleton: /opt/enforce-toolbox/skeletons/semgrep_check.py (Semgrep finds the code; judge() decides, and computes what Semgrep cannot)

Rule syntax: https://semgrep.dev/docs/writing-rules/rule-syntax

# Target card: Function / method (Source code › Function / method)

(node: /opt/enforce-toolbox/targets/source-code/function-method.md)
target · A function or a method.

- where: in the source files; read them with a parser (/opt/enforce-toolbox/skeletons/names_python.py, /opt/enforce-toolbox/skeletons/names_js.py), or with Semgrep patterns
- which files: every file that holds code, decided when the check runs (/opt/enforce-toolbox/targets/source-code/source-file.md); take embedded code out of its container first (a `<script>` in HTML), then parse it

Rule R8: 你的所有回复都必须在结尾处加上"哒～"语气词

- Enforcer: Regex validator (Validation › Regex › Regex validator)
- Trigger: Response sent (Agent loop › Response sent), timing: before
- Target: Response / message (Agent output › Response / message)
